tools.name: elevenlabs_get_user_info
tools.description: Get the account behind the API key: user id, workspace id, first name, and whether onboarding is complete. Good first call to confirm which account is connected. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_subscription
tools.description: Get the plan tier, character usage and limit, when the character count resets, voice slots used and allowed, and billing status. Use it before large generation jobs. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/user/subscription.

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_models
tools.description: List the speech models of the ElevenLabs API, with each model id and name. Use a model id from here in speech history filters. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/models.

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_voices
tools.description: List voices in this account's library: id, name, category, labels, and preview URL. Filter by search text, voice type or category. Returns next_page_token when more voices exist. ElevenLabs API: GET /v2/voices.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_voice
tools.description: Get one voice by id: name, category, labels, description, sharing state, and verified languages. Set with_settings to include its default generation settings. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_voice_settings
tools.description: Get the generation settings of one voice: stability, similarity boost, style, speed, speaker boost. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}/settings.

tools.name: elevenlabs_search_shared_voices
tools.description: Search the public ElevenLabs voice library: name, gender, age, accent, language, use cases and usage count. Use it to find a voice id to add to the account. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/shared-voices.

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_speech_history
tools.description: List past speech generations on this account: history item id, voice, model, text, date, and character count change. Filter by voice, model, text search or date. Returns last_history_item_id to page on. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/history.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_speech_history_item
tools.description: Get one speech history item by id: text, voice, model, output format, settings, state and date. The audio itself is not returned. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/history/{history_item_id}.

tools.name: elevenlabs_delete_speech_history_item
tools.description: Delete one speech history item from this account. The generated audio for that item is removed and cannot be recovered. ElevenLabs API: DELETE /v1/history/{history_item_id}.
